Top-left, add two callout boxes (white fill, #CC0000 1.5pt border, red bold Arial ~12pt, centered): box 1 at ~6%/11% sized ~24%x8% with line 1 'Multi-head  Encoder-Decoder' (set 'Encoder-Decoder' italic + underlined) and line 2 'Attention Block'; box 2 at ~6%/25% with line 1 'Masked Multi-head  Self' ('Self' italic + underlined) and line 2 'Attention Block'. 4. Stack inside, top to bottom: (a) five groups of 4-5 small squares alternating #FFFF99 and #FFA6B9, each group with a short downward arrow; (b) full-width #990000 bar, white bold centered 'Residual Connection and Layer Normalization'; (c) full-width #00A800 bar, white bold 'Feed Forward Networks [ One Hidden with  RELU Activation]' with 'RELU' in Courier New bold; (d) repeat the #990000 bar text; (e) five royal-blue (#0010C8) 3D stacked-box shapes evenly spaced, each with white bold 3-line label 'Encode / Decoder / Attention'; (f) at the left edge a red circle 'K' (white letter) and below it a green circle 'V', each with a right-pointing arrow into the first blue box; (g) a blue circle 'Q' centered under each blue box; (h) at the right edge a pink right-arrow above a green right-arrow (outputs). 7. Build the lower container: pale-pink (#FFE1EE) rounded rectangle with magenta (#E040E0) border spanning ~31-90% x, ~53-95% y. Inside: (a) five token-square groups as in step 6a; (b) #990000 bar 'Residual Connection and Layer Normalization'; (c) five #0010C8 3D stacked boxes labeled 'Masked' in #FFFF00, 'Multi-Head' and 'Self Attention' in white; (d) full-width #800080 bar, white bold 'Word and Position Encoding'; (e) five pale-green (#C8E8C8) boxes with dark centered text 'SOS', 'Je', 'me', 'sens', 'malade'; (f) draw thin red, blue and green curved connectors from just above the purple bar fanning up into each masked-attention box. 8.
